gameplay.text: Ability infos (per OP): Tiger Claw — used more or less behind units to maximize passive lifesteal and AoE damage+stagger. Fearless & Steadfast — for units/CC recovery/CC-immunity on max stacks. Samurai March — for static units and disruption; the 2nd hit's CC is "very good vs units." Bloodthirsty — used for stacking or hero CCing/CC-recovery. Dragon's Leap — maximizes PvP damage to heroes, and provides massive 0-to-100 HP recovery on very stacked blobs of units — "be careful to not send it in front of pikes or you're a goner." Avalanche — used in the middle/behind units on max stacks (OP's preference, "or you're a goner") to maximize stagger, survivability, and AoE damage.

"The gameplay is quite straightforward": fight to the sides/behind units with Tiger Claw/Avalanche/Fearless, proc Lifesteal when low HP (preferably before Avalanche/Tiger Claw). Use Samurai March to disrupt static units. Maximize 5-stacks + Lifesteal + Avalanche to become "a demon unit killer in the middle of red with insane recovery" — make sure you're in Bloodcraze or Fearless & Steadfast CC-immune before using Avalanche for CC immunity.

No explicit "Loses to / Struggles vs / Counters" list in this thread — the closest matchup warning is positional (avoid sending Dragon's Leap in front of pike units, or committing Avalanche without being stacked/CC-immune first).
